title: One Active Plan per Vehicle and Renewal Purchases under KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
A vehicle may carry only one active KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans plan. A new plan on a VIN is sold only when no plan on that VIN is active; a plan bought within the renewal window after the previous plan on the same VIN was fulfilled or expired gets the renewal discount off the list price.

## How the rule is read

- **The object is the vehicle, identified by its VIN.** The plans compared are the plans on file that cover the same VIN as the new plan, whoever holds them.
- **The deciding fact is the status of those plans on the company's plan records**, as the records show it before the sale; a statement by the customer about an earlier plan does not replace the record.
- **"Active" is the only blocking status.** A plan on the same VIN whose status is fulfilled, expired or cancelled does not block a new plan under this rule.
- **The renewal discount** is the plan level's renewal discount off the list price of the plan being bought, and applies when the new plan is bought within the plan level's renewal window, counted in calendar days after the date the previous plan on the same VIN was fulfilled or expired. On the plan record, that date is the date the previous plan closed. The renewal discount and the renewal window are set for each plan level.

## Status of existing plans on the same VIN

| Plans on file for the VIN | Effect of this rule on a new plan |
|---|---|
| No plan | Not blocked by this rule |
| A plan with status active | Not sold |
| A plan with status fulfilled | Not blocked by this rule; renewal discount if bought within the renewal window after it was fulfilled |
| A plan with status expired | Not blocked by this rule; renewal discount if bought within the renewal window after it expired |
| A plan with status cancelled | Not blocked by this rule |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

The dates below are example inputs. Take a previous plan on a VIN that was fulfilled with a closing date of the example day D.

- A new plan bought on the last calendar day of the renewal window counted from D is within the window and gets the renewal discount off its list price.
- A new plan bought on the day after that last day is outside the window; the renewal discount is a discount for a plan bought within the window, so it does not apply to that purchase.
- A new plan offered while another plan on the same VIN still shows status active is not sold, whatever the dates.
